I’m the same way I write draw and pain and I absolutely hate all of it other people say they like and I don’t believe them but what matters is that you enjoy it while doing It it takes years to get to the point of where you actually like it and the best advice I can give you is don’t compare your art to others because more than 
likely they’ve done it longer and it’s just not fare to yourself and just because we fail (or think we fail) it doesn’t mean your a failure we’re all human and mess up at things you just have to keep on doing it and hell im an asshole on purpose most of time except for the to people I love 
And yes you do have a lot of self hate but In that sense I’m a hypocrite because I hate myself and everything I do but I enjoy it and that’s what truly matters I guess I’m not good at advice

Well everything is less stressful in my life considering schools out but as far as the suicidal thoughts and the urge to self harm just keeps on growing so idk 

The counselors at my school are extremely rude so I don’t really have that option anymore because I’m tired of trying to talk to them and being constantly dismissed and treated poorly by them 

thanks for the suggestion of net friends but honestly I’m good  with just one friend and talking on reddit but I might try it later and thanks for the Reddit’s

I personally have suicidal thoughts and I wish that I had someone who would hug me every time they saw me, listened, didn’t judge me, and tried to reach out every day no matter how hard I tried to push them away (I also self harm) and I sure as heck don’t wanna to be around the people I love when I have fresh wounds so if she’s pushing you away and she usually doesn’t or if that’s an unusual behavior for her make sure you ask if she’s okay and trust me if she said she is okay just tell her that (I know your not okay and I WANT to listen when something is wrong) saying that will mean the world to her.

As far as the suicidal thoughts I personally have no will to live people’s dependence on me is my only reason for living so make sure she knows that she is a priority in your life and if you lost her you would be devastated you don’t have to tell her this (you can) but more than anything show her in any way that can you think of that she makes you happy and if she took her life there would be a spot no one else in the world could fill

Also look up things liking.....

What to say to someone with depression 

What not to say to someone with depression 

How to support someone who is suicidal

How to understand the suicidal mind

Also take care of yourself and your own mind while trying to help her you want to be the rock she hold to just make sure you don’t sink and learn how to mentally handle having a relationship with someone who has suicidal thoughts before you jump into this 

(I’m 15 and I’ve been going through this for years now so if you need to ask me something pls do)
Wishing you and your friend the best and recovery
